description: Ex-Armee de l'Air Mirage F1CT used as an instructional airframe at the Aerocampus Aquitaine maintenance training campus; photographed there and recorded by Nicolas Pillet's survivor register, last updated 23 January 2025.
The Mirage F1E prototype, held at Aerocampus Aquitaine as an instructional airframe; recorded there by Nicolas Pillet's survivor register, last updated 23 January 2025.

Ex-Aeronautique navale Super Etendard Modernise handed to a school by the Marine's Service de Rayonnement. ARDHAN's February 2025 census places it at the Lycee Flora Tristan in Camblanes-et-Meynac, but ARDHAN flags that school list as out of date and Nicolas Pillet's register puts it at Aerocampus in the neighbouring commune of Latresne; recorded here at Aerocampus.
